title: Kenyan Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty stew inspired by Kenyan and Italian cuisine, featuring tender chicken and vibrant vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the stew spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and water. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
